title: Event-SAMA: Language-Grounded Video Object Segmentation on Neuromorphic Event Streams
abstract: arXiv:2610.39676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Event cameras offer microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range and no motion blur, but referring video object segmentation (RVOS) lacks event-stream datasets and models. We introduce Event-SAMA-239K, a synthetic-event conversion of the SAMA-239K grounded video-chat corpus and all additional SAMA training data: 30,650 video clips and 392,162 images. Optical-flow, FILM or saccade upsampling followed by a linear event generator preserves all mask, referring-expression and dialogue annotations. We also introduce Event-SAMA, adapting SAMA-4B with a two-channel polarity patch embedding initialised from pretrained RGB weights and a zero-initialised event adapter. End-to-end training yields 24.37 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on MeViS valid_u and 22.33 $\mathcal{J}\&\mathcal{F}$ on the converted ReVOS valid subset, establishing the first event-native RVOS baseline (RGB SAMA-4B: 55.4 on MeViS). Frozen RGB SAMA-4B with pseudo-RGB rendering

translated_title: Event-SAMA：基于语言引导的神经形态事件流视频目标分割
translated_abstract: 事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围和无运动模糊的优势，但指代视频目标分割（RVOS）领域目前缺乏事件流数据集和模型。我们提出了Event-SAMA-239K，这是将SAMA-239K grounding视频对话语料库及所有额外SAMA训练数据转换为合成事件的数据集，包含30,650个视频片段和392,162张图像。通过光流、FIM或眼跳上采样，再经过线性事件生成器处理，完整保留了所有掩码、指代表达和对话标注。我们还提出了Event-SAMA模型，通过从预训练RGB权重初始化的双通道极性patch嵌入和零初始化的事件适配器对SAMA-4B进行改造。端到端训练在MeViS valid_u上取得24.37 J&F，在转换后的ReVOS验证子集上取得22.33 J&F，建立了首个事件原生的RVOS基线（RGB SAMA-4B在MeViS上为55.4）。采用伪RGB渲染的冻结RGB SAMA-4B……
tldr: 该论文首次将语言引导的视频目标分割（RVOS）拓展到事件相机领域，构建了首个大规模事件流RVOS数据集Event-SAMA-239K，并通过双通道极性patch嵌入和事件适配器将SAMA-4B改造为首个事件原生RVOS基线模型Event-SAMA。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers language-grounded video object segmentation on neuromorphic event streams by introducing Event-SAMA-239K, the first large-scale event-stream RVOS dataset, and Event-SAMA, the first event-native RVOS baseline adapted from SAMA-4B via two-channel polarity patch embedding and zero-initialised event adapters.
